title: Why I'm Starting This Blog
paragraphs: I've wanted to write in public for a while now, and kept finding reasons to wait. The reasons were always the same shape: not enough time, nothing important enough to say, someone's probably already said it better.

None of that turns out to matter much. This isn't going to be a place for finished thoughts. It's a place for the ones still taking shape — notes, half-ideas, things I noticed and didn't want to lose.
So here's the first one. More soon.
